summary.text: Robby Robbins is a Republican state representative from Dorchester County who has represented South Carolina House District 97 since winning a May 2022 special election and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney, he serves on the Judiciary and Ethics committees and faces Democrat Cathy Jaggars in the general election, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Robby Robbins was born on May 5, 1962, in Charleston and earned a B.A. in 1984 and a J.D. in 1987 from the University of South Carolina, according to the House member page.

Ballotpedia reports that his career includes owning Robert Robbins LLC and working as an attorney at the Thurmond Kirchner & Timbes law firm, and that he served on the boards of Habitat for Humanity, Children in Crisis, the Dorchester Two Educational Foundation and the Summerville/Greater Dorchester County Chamber of Commerce.
Robbins was commissioner of the South Carolina Department of Transportation for the First Congressional District from 2016 to 2022, according to the House member page.
The page says he was elected in a special election on May 17, 2022, to fill the unexpired term of Mandy Kimmons, who had resigned.
His committee assignments are Judiciary and Ethics.
